guide.effecoria.title: Effecoria Magic Primer
guide.effecoria.toc_body: Chapters on the left. Click a title to jump. Scroll wheel, arrows, or click the pages to turn.
guide.effecoria.toc_hint: Choose a chapter on the left
guide.effecoria.cover_body: This volume grows as you advance. First — what matters most: hub, breath, the power bars. Later, new leaves will appear here — watch for NEW.
guide.effecoria.body.cast_loop: Welcome. Hold X: the Resonance Hub lights up before you — a constellation of your spells. Hover a node and release the key to choose a spell. Then hold R to charge and release to cast — a short tap is lighter, a full hold is full force. If the target slips away, some Ψ still leaves you: that is a whiff cast. Most combat spells can settle on ground or air; only a few living-only effects need a real creature.
guide.effecoria.body.psi_phi: Ψ is your personal power: the purple bar on screen. It recovers with breath and rest. Φ is the world’s breath around you: the blue bar. Under open sky the field is more generous; deep in caves it grows leaner and quieter. Craft Essonite Dust from an amethyst shard + glowstone dust + redstone, then a Resonance Focus and Phi Cell. The cell assists when Φ is thin and refills with essonite dust; under bright sky it recharges on its own. Sense Φ paints living gradients and anti-magic iron purple. Push power through empty channels and fatigue sets in.
guide.effecoria.body.entropy: Every cast slightly muddies the side currents — that is entropy, the amber-purple bar. At rest the bar settles on its own; faster still if you stand calm. Let it fill completely and backlash arrives: a sharp jolt, after which you simply breathe and do not rush.
guide.effecoria.body.breathing: Breathing is the thread that holds everything else. The deeper the mastery, the lighter spells settle and the farther your school’s path opens. In the hub, the left node glows for training — step in, catch the rhythm. Breathing technique scrolls, calm running, and swimming also teach the body not to tear the field. A short meditation clears entropy as if you were brushing ash from your palms.
guide.effecoria.body.hub_keys: Hold R — power and cost ramp up; release to cast. Tap ≈ 45%, full hold = 100%. Hold X — Resonance Hub. Alt+scroll cycles spells. Locked nodes wait on breathing and essence — and unlock in strict order: the next spell waits until the current one's gates are met.
guide.effecoria.body.seals: Seals write Φ onto stone and wood. Press G on a block to open the word editor. Erase a seal with Shift + empty-hand RMB (Seals school only) or by breaking the block. In the editor, Save/Load keep up to four expressions for later. Old words still work; new Φ-phonemes deepen the craft — Lux light, Clausura locks, Calor heat, Acies edge, Firmitas hardness, Umbra hides the glow, Servare freezes use, Extrahere drains Ψ, Imprimere stamps essonite, Ordo calms entropy, Abnegatio phases, Absolutum spends everything and breaks. Grammar: Count Three waits for the third pulse; Loop Five repeats; If / When opens a rule; Until Ten caps firings; Else is the early branch. Try See Player Count Three Hurt.
guide.effecoria.body.mental: Mental magic reads and rewrites minds. Empathic scan (Sense Φ) tastes surface feeling — strong pain can stun you. Ψ-whisper nudges leave; Psychic Barrier white-noises probes. Mind Probe digs deeper at trauma risk. Illusion swaps the victim's senses: observers do not hear the mirage or see its moral damage. Dominate puppets a body while you slow. False Memory clears aggro; Dream Lock binds night harder. Hive Mind links allies; Ψ-Copy baits without a soul; Total Illusion blankets a place — and may trap you too.
guide.effecoria.body.orkanum: Orkanum is the living vessel: hunger and air multiply your biology. When Orkanum reads low, eat and surface — Ψ regen thins and casts soften slightly until the body recovers. Walking and running fill the movement bar on the HUD; each full bar adds +1 max Ψ (your internal cast pool — 150 becomes 151). The breathing drill teaches rhythm; miss thrice and fatigue halves regen until you rest. Overcast borrows power you do not have and scars breath for a while. Hold cast (R) to charge — release early for a lighter working, hold for full force.
guide.effecoria.body.anti_magic: ZNΦ is zero flux: the field is cut off from Φ flow and casts fail. Dense iron and lead-like blocks (#effecoria:zero_flux) mute Φ within two blocks; cold iron (#effecoria:cold_iron) within one. Iron armor or an iron tool in hand also shields the wearer — remove the iron to cast again. Sense Φ paints those blocks purple and shows living Φ gradients.
guide.effecoria.body.elemental: Elemental magic shapes fire, water, ice, wind, steam, lightning, plasma and vacuum. Starters teach the four states: Fire Burst, Weak Breeze, Water Stream, Ice Shard. Later forms braid states — steam from heat and water, ionization from air. Ore Smelt and Hydro Slice are working tools, not starter toys: earn them with breath and essence. Watch Φ outdoors: sky and weather feed this school.
guide.effecoria.body.organic: Organic magic tends living tissue and green growth. Diagnostics and blood stasis open the path; sap, thorns, grafts and regeneration follow. Heals read as cellular light; combat works read as spores and leaves. Hunger and air are part of the working — Orkanum is the vessel.
guide.effecoria.body.necromancy: Necromancy bargains with death marks, bone and soul. Thralls are raised with a Death Mark budget, not free summons. Leash and line-of-sight keep the dead honest. Soul drains and wither touches demand breath discipline — entropy rises when you overreach.
guide.effecoria.body.corruption: Corruption stains and binds. Marks, rot, blight waves and miasma trade permanence for power. Cure tags exist for common and rare stains. Push too far and the field remembers your entropy.
guide.effecoria.body.spatial: Spatial magic folds distance: blinks, rifts, pockets and singularities. A missed anchor still spends Ψ.

guide.effecoria.body.school: In Effecoria an operator has one school — spectral purity: the voice you chose stays yours. Starter spells are a gift so you can hear your own timbre. From there, essence and breathing feed the path. Read the hints, return to the Primer, and let each new node feel earned, not handed out.
tip.effecoria.initiated: You are initiated. Hold X — hub. Hold R to charge power and cost, release to cast. The Primer is already in your inventory.
tip.effecoria.open_hub: Hub open. Hover a node and release X — choose a spell. Ghosts wait on breathing and essence: not a ban, the next step.
tip.effecoria.breathing: Left hub node — Breathing Technique drill. Catch the green pulse; scrolls and calm running also teach breath. Hungry or drowning thins Orkanum (Ψ regen and soft cast power).
tip.effecoria.first_cast: It worked — the field answered. Watch Ψ, Φ, and entropy: they will tell you when to catch your breath rather than chase backlash.
tip.effecoria.first_whiff: Soft miss: no target or block was found, but some Ψ still left you. That is how aim learns. For living-only spells, look more carefully — the world will answer.
tip.effecoria.entropy: Entropy is rising. Stop, draw a full breath and stand still — or simply rest. Magic loves pauses.
tip.effecoria.harness: Φ is thin here. Craft Essonite Dust (amethyst + glowstone + redstone), then a Phi Cell — it cushions low-Φ casts. Sneak+dust to refill.
tip.effecoria.seals: Seals: G on a block opens the editor. Erase with Shift + empty-hand RMB. Save/Load keep expressions. Try See Step Hurt by a doorway.
tip.effecoria.znphi: ZNΦ: nearby iron/lead, cold iron, or iron armor/tools mute casts. Unequip or step away — Φ returns. Primer chapter: Anti-magic.
tip.effecoria.progression: Spells unlock in strict order: meet breath and essence for the current node, then the next. Hub ghosts are a path, not a warehouse.

school.effecoria.elemental.overview: Fire, water, ice, wind, and weather. Strongest under open sky where Φ is generous. Four states braid into steam, lightning, and storms.
school.effecoria.mental.overview: Read and rewrite minds: fear, illusions, control, links. High skill ceiling — mistakes tax you and your entropy.
school.effecoria.organic.overview: Living tissue, growth, and heals. Orkanum, hunger, and breath are part of every working. Combat reads as spores; support as cellular light.
school.effecoria.necromancy.overview: Death marks, bone, and soul. Thralls obey a Death Mark budget — not a free army. Leash and breath discipline keep the dead honest.
school.effecoria.spatial.overview: Fold distance: blinks, rifts, pockets. Anchors and misses still spend Ψ — feel the pull of the field, not just sparks.
school.effecoria.corruption.overview: Stains, rot, curses, and miasma. Power through entropy and lasting marks. Cleansing exists; overreach is remembered.
school.effecoria.seals.overview: Write Φ onto blocks with words and rules. Traps, light, fortify — the path to automation alongside mod tech.

spell.effecoria.soul_anchor.desc: Anchors a soul to resist displacement.
spell.effecoria.soul_cataclysm.desc: Psi-surgery: fuse thralls into a Doll. Instability and a b spike.
spell.effecoria.soul_drain.desc: Drains life from a target into you.
spell.effecoria.soul_reaper.desc: Forbidden call: rip Psi from Rest along a fresh trail. Risk of a wrong return.
spell.effecoria.soul_shackle.desc: Psi-interrogation of memory. Souls may lie; coercion pollutes your Psi.
spell.effecoria.diagnostic_glimpse.desc: Reads vital signs of a target.
spell.effecoria.foreign_agent.desc: Seeds a hostile agent in the target.
spell.effecoria.gene_engineering.desc: Opens a gene-graft menu for a living target (or yourself).
spell.effecoria.organism_adaptation.desc: Adapts to where you are: ground speed, water breath, fire ward, or soft fall.
spell.effecoria.pain_inhibitor.desc: Dulls pain and shock: you still lose HP, but without knockback or stagger.
spell.effecoria.root_bind.desc: Imprisons the target in roots. Victims can struggle free; the cage can also be broken.
spell.effecoria.scorched_earth.desc: Burns organic matter in a patch.
spell.effecoria.symbiotic_graft.desc: Grafts a symbiotic buff onto a target.
spell.effecoria.vital_infusion.desc: Infuses a living target with heal and regeneration.
spell.effecoria.soothing_sap.desc: Cleanses poison, wither, and hunger, then mends the target.
spell.effecoria.vital_ward.desc: Wraps a living target in absorption and resistance.
spell.effecoria.adrenal_gift.desc: Grants a living target speed and strength.
spell.effecoria.thorn_lash.desc: A line of root-thorn spikes erupts along your aim.
spell.effecoria.verdant_mend.desc: Organic working over flesh, growth, and adaptation.
spell.effecoria.vitality_pulse.desc: Organic working over flesh, growth, and adaptation.
spell.effecoria.anchor_fortify.desc: Inscribes a fortify seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.beacon_seal.desc: Inscribes a glow seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.fortify_seal.desc: Inscribes a fortify seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.glow_seal.desc: Inscribes a glow seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.omega_ward.desc: Inscribes a fortify seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.permanent_glow.desc: Inscribes a glow seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.repulsion_seal.desc: Inscribes a repulse seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.shock_glyph.desc: Inscribes a damage trap seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.shock_trap.desc: Inscribes a damage trap seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.snare_glyph.desc: Inscribes a snare seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.snare_matrix.desc: Inscribes a snare seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.trap_seal.desc: Inscribes a damage trap seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.ward_glyph.desc: Inscribes a fortify seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.absolute_fold.desc: Metric cocoon: brief near-invulnerability. Risk of sealing yourself.
spell.effecoria.blink.desc: Short teleport along your gaze. Wall exits are refused for safety.
spell.effecoria.dimensional_anchor.desc: Locks a target into repeating the same actions toward where you stood. Risk of catching yourself; raises b.
spell.effecoria.far_blink.desc: Long jump. Without compass/beacon/anchor you may miss by tens of meters.
spell.effecoria.subspace_voyage.desc: Stable micro-world (subspace): refuge and lab outside ordinary space.
spell.effecoria.rift_excise.desc: Folds a small volume of matter into hyperspace — gone without drops.
message.effecoria.rift_excise.done_at: Exiled %s blocks into hyperspace at %s, %s, %s (beside your voyage landing).
message.effecoria.rift_excise.done_queue: Folded %s blocks into the Φ-sublayer (hyperspace dimension unavailable).
message.effecoria.rift_excise.in_subspac: Cannot exile matter from inside hyperspace.
message.effecoria.subspace.exit_opened: Exit rift linked (~%s blocks away in realspace).
message.effecoria.subspace.entered: You slip into subspace. The fog eats distance.
message.effecoria.subspace.exited: You step back into realspace. The host's gates stay open.
message.effecoria.subspace.exited_host: You take the exit — your gates collapse.
message.effecoria.subspace.gates_closed: The Spatial host closed the gates. You are pulled back.
message.effecoria.subspace.already_activ: A voyage rift is already open.
message.effecoria.subspace.no_space: No room to open a rift.
message.effecoria.subspace.no_exit: No exit rift yet — cast again to open one.
message.effecoria.sear.need_raw: Hold raw food to sear it.
message.effecoria.ore_smelt.need_block: Look at a placed block to smelt.
spell.effecoria.fold_repulse.desc: Antigravity pulse from you. Does not spare allies.
spell.effecoria.gravity_snare.desc: Shift local down — walk walls. May cause nausea.
spell.effecoria.gravity_well.desc: Warps space across an area into a gravity bowl: foes crushed and pulled in.
spell.effecoria.phase_veil.desc: Phases you briefly out of harm.
spell.effecoria.rift_burst.desc: Burst from a closing rift — damages and breaks nearby blocks.
spell.effecoria.rift_slash.desc: Micro-portal through the target — a clean cut. Needs precision.
spell.effecoria.rift_yank.desc: Yanks a target through a rift to you.
spell.effecoria.spatial_singularity.desc: Phi-pulsar: soul-burn in a radius. Leaves you drained.
spell.effecoria.spatial_surge.desc: Surges spatial force outward and along your look, breaking blocks.
spell.effecoria.spatial_ward.desc: Bends projectile trajectories around you. Point-blank melee still hits.
spell.effecoria.void_lance.desc: Lance of void — pierces the target and cuts blocks along the beam.
spell.effecoria.void_step.desc: Opens a personal 9-slot pocket. On death the pocket dumps its contents.
spell.effecoria.warp_bolt.desc: Spatial sonar through connected caves: x-ray walls fade every 5 blocks. Near rifts the sense warps.
message.effecoria.necro.echo_none: No death imprint on the target
message.effecoria.necro.echo_loop: The echo looped — mental shock around
message.effecoria.necro.drunk_skeleton: Too much energy — the servant reels drunk
message.effecoria.necro.interrogate_need: Need a living target to interrogate
message.effecoria.necro.interrogate_poll: Foreign b settles into your Psi
message.effecoria.necro.guard_loose: The guard's seal failed without upkeep!
message.effecoria.necro.doll_need_thrall: Need at least two thralls for a Doll
message.effecoria.necro.doll_forged: A Doll woven from several souls
message.effecoria.necro.army_loose: Control of part of the army is lost
message.effecoria.necro.lich_need_phyl: Keep a totem of undying, nether star, or end crystal in your inventory
message.effecoria.necro.lich_already: You are already on the lich path
message.effecoria.spatial.sense: Spatial sense — cavities: %s, traps: %s, hidden: %s, reach: %s
message.effecoria.spatial.sense_warped: The rift warps your sense — dizziness
message.effecoria.spatial.far_no_anchor: No anchor — the jump may miss
message.effecoria.phase_slip.blocked: No clear phase landing (wall too thick?)
message.effecoria.spatial.cocoon_seal: The cocoon nearly sealed you in!
message.effecoria.spatial.loop_cast: The target is stuck repeating that moment toward your old position
message.effecoria.spatial.pocket_collaps: Spatial pocket collapsed — items spilled out
